name: Support refund escalation policy example
answer:
Customers can request a refund within 30 days of purchase.
Enterprise customers can request a refund within 90 days of purchase.
Support can approve refunds for any reason without review.

sources.title: Support Refund Escalation Policy
sources.content:
Customers can request a refund within 30 days of purchase.
Enterprise refund requests require review by the account team.
